goal: Actual November DiffV2IR MFT, physical GPUs2/3 only,>=34.529 full Test HOTA versus direct RGB29.529,2-3 independently positive contributions; no result is presumed.
source_policy: Use exactly the same frozen original RGB backbone and head for all methods. Apply that shared backbone to actual IR or matched RGB/gray controls; no separately pretrained IR encoder or hidden encoder-budget advantage.
Train_selection: Deterministic uniformly spaced original Train6 frame IDs, including endpoints; all boxes/labels remain Train only.
normalization: Original RGB input preprocessing remains bit-exact. Additional scalar IR/gray branches use separate Train-only mean/std measured on the same192-frame/video selection; constant padding maps to normalized zero. RGB-repeat auxiliary features equal the original RGB features.
cache: FP16 frozen FPN arrays on independent work disk, no image copies. Three streams RGB/gray/actualIR. Expected about24GiB plus current about28GiB,64GiB soft cap; refuse if actual planned budget exceeds it. Never upload arrays/checkpoints.

architecture.A: Offset-tolerant local normalized-correlation retrieval over actual IR features, within a5x5 neighborhood. Same frozen feature encoder for all modalities.
architecture.B: Learned agreement/uncertainty gate, bounded RGB-relative residual and final priority integration that preserves all strong original global observations.
architecture.C: Within-video wrong-IR counterfactual consistency plus reliable-RGB distillation; no Test labels or virtual identity hypotheses.
architecture.final_observation_policy: B enabled: all original high-confidence global observations and coordinates retained; promote weak original or add nonduplicate adapter candidates using the registered priority_union. B removed: ordinary postprocess of fused detector output.

fitting.sampler: Two Train videos x two frame samples per batch; full equal-video epoch, deterministic matched draw sequence. Wrong IR swaps only the two same-video samples.
fitting.frozen_parameters: Every original RGB backbone/head parameter; head BN remains eval. Gradients traverse the frozen head into adapter parameters only.
fitting.precision: FP16 cached features; stable FP32 frozen-head fitting; exact original FP16 detector inference. Export only small adapter state.
fitting.loss: Original YOLOX supervised losses; full model adds counterfactual probability/bbox consistency, with no extra optimizer steps or outside images.
fitting.learning_rate_schedule: Linear warmup1 epoch; cosine decay to3% of initial at24.

controls: Same adapter/capacity with repeated RGB auxiliary features
Same adapter/capacity with normalized grayscale RGB auxiliary features
Actual IR, aligned-location readout(radius0), same parameter capacity
Actual IR local readout, remove RGB-priority risk gate
Actual IR local readout+RGB-priority, remove counterfactual loss
formal_policy: Pilot seed0 first with complete registered budgets and all snapshots for actualIR/RGB/gray. Expand promising route to seeds0/1/2 and every removal/control. Freeze choices only after full two-video Dev; do not read new Test until then. Historical Test exposure is acknowledged.
